candidates.name: Islander East Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: KeySpan / Duke Energy (Islander East Pipeline Co.)

evidence.note: Application for about 50 miles of 24-inch pipeline from Connecticut across Long Island Sound to Long Island.
FERC final certificate; about 50.4 miles, 22.6 offshore.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row with this name or endpoints (P0233 NYMarc, P0171 Constitution are different). About 81 km. Certificated by FERC but not built.

candidates.name: Algonquin HubLine Project

evidence.note: FERC applications for about 30 miles of offshore pipe across Massachusetts Bay plus 5 miles of lateral.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster by name. Might overlap P0149 Algonquin Main Line (len 1131) or P0154 Atlantic Bridge, but those are other projects. About 48 km offshore. Build year about 2003; verify with EIA seeds for duplicate.

candidates.name: Iroquois Eastchester Extension Project

evidence.note: Federal Register notice for the Eastchester Extension, about 30 to 33 miles of 24-inch pipe under Long Island Sound.

candidates.why_maybe_new: P0205 Iroquois (Waddington->Bronx, len 669) may already include this reach, so this may be a segment of it, not new. Consolidator should decide. About 50 km.

candidates.name: Rockies Express Entrega Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Rockies Express Pipeline (originally Entrega Gas Pipeline)
candidates.from: Meeker Hub, Rio Blanco County, CO
candidates.to: Cheyenne Hub, Weld County, CO via Wamsutter, WY

evidence.note: 327-mile 36 and 42-inch line, FERC approved August 2005, in service 2006.

candidates.why_maybe_new: P0246 REX Main Line (len 1685) probably covers it as the Entrega/Zone 1 segment; separate segment row may be wanted. About 528 km. Might be a duplicate of an EIA seed.

candidates.name: Palomar Gas Transmission Pipeline
candidates.to: Molalla, OR (Northwest Pipeline Grants Pass Lateral)

evidence.note: FERC application for 217 miles of 36-inch pipeline.
TransCanada announcement of the certificate application.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Possible overlap with P2626 Trail West/N-MAX (Madras->Molalla, 106 km, cancelled), which is a different Northwest Pipeline proposal along a similar corridor. Palomar is about 350 km. Withdrawn after Bradwood failed.

candidates.name: Oregon Pipeline (Oregon LNG bidirectional pipeline)
candidates.sponsor: Oregon Pipeline Company / LNG Development Co.

evidence.note: FERC draft EIS for Oregon LNG and the 86.8-mile 36-inch pipeline.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Oregon LNG pipeline. About 140 km. Starts in Oregon (in slice). Related Washington Expansion Project (Northwest Pipeline looping) is a separate possible row; not separately verified.

candidates.name: Bradwood Landing Pipeline

evidence.note: FERC approval of Bradwood Landing LNG with a 36.3-mile sendout pipeline.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster. P5101 Kalama Lateral is different. About 58 km. FERC approved, never built.
